name: io.github.zalez/perplexity-agent-mcp
title: Perplexity Agent
description: Multi-step web research with citations through Perplexity's Agent API. Single file, Python standard library only, no MCP SDK.

environmentVariables.name: PERPLEXITY_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your Perplexity API key. Read at call time and sent only as an Authorization header to api.perplexity.ai; never logged or echoed.

environmentVariables.name: PERPLEXITY_AGENT_WAIT_SECONDS
environmentVariables.description: How long a blocking call waits before handing back a response_id to collect later. Defaults to 55, just inside Claude Desktop's unconfigurable 60s tool-call timeout. Raise to 300 on clients without that limit.
